y_true.description: Ground truth labels. Expected to contain *integer class indices* with shape `[batch_size]` or `[batch_size, 1]`.

y_pred.description: The predicted class probabilities, with shape `[batch_size, num_classes]`.

q.description: Float in range `(0, 1)`. It is the noise parameter. Controls the behavior of the loss: - As `q` approaches 0: Behaves more like cross entropy - As `q` approaches 1: Behaves more like mean absolute error
constraints: q must be a float in range (0, 1)
